description: This file defines a 'Style' class with methods for handling CSS styles in a rich text editor context, including retrieving, applying, and manipulating styles on DOM nodes and ranges.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: A class providing methods to manipulate and retrieve CSS styles within a rich text editing environment.

methods.name: jQueryCSS
methods.description: Handles CSS property retrieval with compatibility for older jQuery versions.

methods.name: fromNode
methods.description: Extracts style information from a DOM node.

methods.name: stylePara
methods.description: Applies style information to paragraph nodes within a range.

methods.name: styleNodes
methods.description: Inserts or manipulates style nodes within a range, with options for node type and sibling expansion.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Retrieves the current style state at the cursor position, including font styles, list styles, and other formatting.
